contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [--]CONSTAN [--]?V AVG ; R/ VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17, Trier mint. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Obverse inscription: [--]CONSTAN [--]?V AVG. Reverse description: two Victories facing each other holding wreaths; indistinct symbol between them. Reverse inscription: VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN. In exergue: TR[-]. Diameter: 15.7mm, Weight: 1.11gms, die axis: 6
